How do I receive a truck at the dock?
Open Fleet → Arrivals, or scan the lot QR code from Orders. Check the temperature and confirm the reception.
What do I do with a temperature alert?
Open the alert from Home or Sensors, check the temperature trend and contact the driver. The cold chain certificate records every event.
How do I approve or reject a lot?
Go to Quality → Lots, open the lot and record your decision with its reason.
Can I work without signal?
Yes. The app shows the data saved on this phone and updates it when the connection is back. You can force it in My account → Data and sync.
